title: Examiner Tour — RQ1a: Being-With Participants
description: A guided reading path for examiners exploring RQ1a: In what ways do participants in such a setting affect my being-with them? This tour begins with the clearest first instance of participant affect, moves to the cluster's recurrence and anticipatory being-with, then visits the essay for the theoretical scaffold via Barad and Deleuze.

steps.commentary: The clearest first instance of participant affect: S3's joke disrupts boredom, producing a visible affective shift. Edge-002 (enables) and edge-004 (disrupts) are the structural backbone of RQ1a here.

Cluster recurrence and anticipatory being-with: S3 arrives early and rearranges a chair, then restores it. The theory-laughter bridge assembles. This encounter shows RQ1a operating across time — not a single event but a pattern of being-affected.
